properties.name: Fields West
properties.developer: The Karahan Companies and Hunt Realty
properties.cost: $800 million; secured a $425 million construction loan for Phase 1 in 2025
properties.details: 55-acre development in Fields Frisco with 380,000 square feet of retail space, 350,000 square feet of office space, 1,300 multifamily units and planned boutique hotel.
properties.progress: Phase 1 is 75% pre-leased and 80% committed; phased opening from 2027 into 2028

properties.name: Fields Frisco
properties.developer: The Karahan Companies and Hunt Realty
properties.details: 2,545-acre master-planned community, including 11 million square feet of office space, 1 million square feet of retail space, 5,000 single-family residences, 8,500 multifamily units and 250 acres of open space and parks.
properties.tenants: Universal Studios kid-friendly theme park, PGA of America headquarters, Omni PGA Resort

properties.name: PGA Frisco Campus
properties.developer: A public-private partnership of the PGA of America, Omni Hotels & Resorts, the City of Frisco and Frisco ISD, within the Fields development by The Karahan Companies and Hunt Realty
properties.cost: About $520 million for the Omni PGA Frisco Resort; $33.5 million for the PGA of America headquarters
properties.details: 660-acre mixed-use project containing PGA's 106,000-square-foot corporate headquarters, two 18-hole golf courses, and the 600,000-square-foot Omni PGA Frisco Resort.
properties.progress: Active; Fields Ranch Pavilion planned for spring 2027

properties.name: The Star
properties.details: 91-acre campus of the Dallas Cowboys World Headquarters and practice facility.
properties.tenants: Dallas Cowboys headquarters and practice facility, TIAA Frisco Corporate Center, Baylor Scott & White Health

properties.name: Star Business Park
properties.address: 8101 Corporate Way, at Preston Road and Rockhill Parkway
properties.developer: Blue Star Land, with Lincoln Property Company
properties.details: 238-acre development planned to accommodate 2 million square feet of industrial space and 422,000 square feet of office.
properties.progress: Various stages; active leasing and expansion underway

properties.name: The Mix
properties.address: Dallas Parkway and Lebanon Road (former Wade Park site)
properties.details: 112-acre, $3 billion development that will feature two hotels, 3,299 apartment units, 2 million square feet of office space, 375,000 square feet for retail and a 9-acre park.
properties.progress: Phase 1 under construction, with completion estimated in 2028; the full project will take decades

properties.name: Hall Park
properties.details: 162-acre mixed-use development in Frisco with more than 2.2 million square feet of office space across 16 office buildings. The $7 billion master plan envisions approximately 9.5 million square feet of total usable space, including residential towers, a boutique hotel, restaurants, retail space and a park.
properties.progress: Phase 1 complete; construction has started on Terraces Hall Park, a 200,000-square-foot office tower set for completion by 2028
properties.tenants: Public Storage headquarters, Chobani corporate center

properties.name: Toyota Stadium District
properties.cost: $215 million stadium renovation underway; full district cost not determined
properties.details: 250-key hotel, 15,000 square feet of convention and meeting space and 30,000 square feet of retail and restaurant space around Toyota Stadium.
properties.progress: Pre-construction, with $5 million in city incentives; groundbreaking planned for 2027

properties.name: Firefly Park
properties.details: 217-acre mixed-use project, featuring 45-acre park, 400,000 square feet of retail space, over 3 million square feet of office space, 230 townhomes, 1,200 hotel rooms, 1,970 multifamily units and a park with bike trails, an amphitheater and a wedding chapel.

properties.name: Southstone Yards
properties.details: 45-acre project anchored by seven-story, 242,000 square-foot timber office building. It will feature 1,000 residential units at full build-out.
properties.tenants: A Toyota financial services division leased the timber office building

properties.name: Frisco Station
properties.developer: Frisco Station Partnership, composed of The Rudman Partnership, Hillwood Properties, and VanTrust Real Estate
properties.details: 242-acre mixed use development, with 2,400 residences, 3 million square feet of office space, 86,000 square feet of retail space, 500,000 square feet of medical offices, 70 homes and 30 acres of green space.
properties.progress: Phase 1 completed December 2017; full build-out ongoing

properties.name: Canals at Grand Park
properties.developer: Arcadia Realty Corporation and Charter Holdings
properties.details: 152-acre, $500 million development featuring nearly 2,000 single family homes, senior living and multifamily residences.
properties.progress: Construction finished; open for lease or occupancy

properties.name: Railhead
properties.developer: Heady Investments, JPI Developments, Wallace Ventures
properties.details: 80-acre mixed use development with 1.5 million square feet of office space, 200-key hotel, 250,000 square feet of retail and 1,300 multifamily residences.
properties.progress: JPI completed the first two phases; a third phase will add 377 units
